newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian soldier kills two, wounds three others.
newsitem.headline: Russian soldier kills two, wounds three others.

text.p: A Russian soldier shot dead his patrol commander and a private and wounded three others on Wednesday while they were escorting a convoy of prisoners at a railway station, Itar-Tass news agency said.
Alexander Hasanov opened fire on his interior ministry colleagues at a small station as the convoy travelled from Moscow to the town of Bryansk southwest of the capital, it said.
Local police helped catch Hasanov and an interior ministry commission has begun an investigation.
The interior ministry was not immediately available to comment on the report, which was also carried by Interfax news agency.
Violent incidents, including bullying, suicides and robberies, have risen sharply in Russia's armed forces as cash shortages take their toll on morale.
In October, two new recruits shot dead four comrades in the Russian far east and ran off with weapons and ammunition.
In a separate incident, several soldiers were blown to bits when they tried to dismantle a missile, apparently intending to sell off its parts.

Last week Defence Minister Igor Rodionov said Russia faced a catastrophe unless it took extreme measures to reform the army, although he toned down his remarks on Tuesday, saying the situation had eased.

Rodionov has played down talk of a military rebellion but has said repeatedly that the army's problems, which include acute shortages in equipment and supplies and wage delays, could soon spin out of control unless defence spending is increased.
